title: Write a message to a file and read it
description: Open notes.txt in write mode and save a short message. Open it in read mode and print the message.
solution:
with open("note.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("Hello file")
with open("note.txt", "r") as file:
    print(file.read())

title: Add another message to a file
description: Write one message to notes.txt. Open the file in append mode to add a second message. Read and print both messages.
solution:
with open("log.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("A")
with open("log.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("B")
with open("log.txt", "r") as file:

title: Write and print two file lines
description: Write two lines in a file. Read the file with a for loop and print each line.
solution:
with open("items.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("pen\nbook")
with open("items.txt", "r") as file:
    for line in file:
        print(line.strip())

title: Count the characters in a file
description: Write some text to a file. Read it, use len() to count the characters, and print the count.
solution:
with open("data.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("CodeBolt")
with open("data.txt", "r") as file:
    text = file.read()
print(len(text))

title: Read and print the whole file
description: Write at least two lines to a file. Read the whole file at once and print all its text.
solution:
lines = ["one", "two", "three"]
with open("list.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("\n".join(lines))
with open("list.txt", "r") as file:
    print(file.read())
